Strict goal review category=scope_fragmented; reason=The candidate name 'Manage Account Settings' aggregates three distinct, independently initiatable operations: changing personal details/password (EC-G-001), editing general account info (EC-G-000 duplicate), and managing email notification preferences (EC-G-003). The evidence describes these as separate page sections (Section 6.11 vs 6.12) with specific, non-overlapping data domains. A user can complete one task (e.g., change password) without triggering or completing the others, violating the atomic completion state requirement. The 'Manage' umbrella implies a cohesive workflow that does not exist in the evidence; instead, the evidence presents a menu of independent sub-goals..
